groups.name: Bato Dela Rosa Senate Shooting and ICC Warrant
groups.name_zh: 德拉罗萨参议院枪击案与ICC逮捕令
groups.narrative: Legal and political fallout continues regarding Senator Bato dela Rosa's involvement in a Senate shooting incident and the denial of his petition to halt an ICC arrest warrant.
groups.narrative_zh: 关于参议员德拉罗萨涉及参议院枪击事件及最高法院驳回其针对国际刑事法院逮捕令的临时禁制令请求，法律与政治余波仍在持续。
groups.R_reason: Specific legal outcomes involving arrest warrants or court petitions are highly objective.
groups.S_reason: Supreme Court of the Philippines or ICC registry.
groups.T_reason: Legal proceedings are time-sensitive but depend on court pace.
groups.U_reason: High uncertainty regarding legal maneuvers and enforcement.
groups.H_reason: High level of public and political attention.
groups.suggested_question: Will an arrest warrant for Bato Dela Rosa be served by December 31, 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 到2026年12月31日，德拉罗萨参议员是否会被执行逮捕令？
groups.resolution_source: Supreme Court of the Philippines / Official Department of Justice announcements

groups.name: Sara Duterte Impeachment Trial
groups.name_zh: 萨拉·杜特尔特弹劾案
groups.narrative: The House of Representatives is actively organizing the prosecution team and trial procedures for the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte.
groups.narrative_zh: 众议院正在积极组织针对副总统萨拉·杜特尔特的弹劾检控团队及审理程序。
groups.R_reason: Impeachment trial completion is a formal legislative outcome.
groups.S_reason: House of Representatives / Senate (as an impeachment court).
groups.T_reason: The trial progress follows formal legislative sessions.
groups.U_reason: Political volatility makes the outcome highly uncertain.
groups.suggested_question: Will the House of Representatives vote to impeach Vice President Sara Duterte by year-end 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 到2026年底，众议院是否会投票弹劾副总统萨拉·杜特尔特？
groups.resolution_source: House of Representatives of the Philippines official journals

groups.name: Philippine-Japan Friendship and Security
groups.name_zh: 菲律宾与日本友好关系及安全合作
groups.narrative: President Marcos and the First Lady are fostering Philippines-Japan ties ahead of a state visit focused on security and energy cooperation, amidst ongoing scrutiny of Japan's historical militarism.
groups.narrative_zh: 在马科斯总统即将对日进行旨在加强安全与能源合作的国事访问之际，菲日关系在关注日本历史军国主义的背景下持续互动。
groups.R_reason: Bilateral agreements vary in scope, making 'new agreements' a broad category.
groups.T_reason: Dependent on the state visit schedule.
groups.U_reason: Likely to occur, but specific terms are opaque.
groups.H_reason: Moderate coverage in regional and international news.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Philippines and Japan sign a new Reciprocal Access Agreement (RAA) or similar defense pact during the 2026 state visit?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 菲律宾与日本是否会在2026年国事访问期间签署新的互惠准入协议或类似防御条约？
groups.resolution_source: Department of Foreign Affairs of the Philippines

groups.name: Luzon and Visayas Power Grid Stability
groups.name_zh: 吕宋和米沙鄢电网稳定性
groups.narrative: Repeated red alerts and rotational blackouts across Luzon and Visayas grids are causing significant concerns about energy supply reliability.
groups.narrative_zh: 吕宋和米沙鄢电网频繁发出红色警报并进行轮流停电，引发了对能源供应可靠性的担忧。
groups.R_reason: Power grid status is officially monitored by the DOE.
groups.S_reason: Department of Energy (DOE) and NGCP official advisories.
groups.U_reason: High frequency of outages makes short-term prediction volatile.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Luzon power grid be placed under 'Red Alert' status at any point in June 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年6月，吕宋电网是否会被列入“红色预警”状态？

groups.name: Alsons Power Solar Transition
groups.name_zh: Alsons电力设施转型太阳能
groups.narrative: Alsons Power is transitioning a 55 MW diesel plant into a 98.7 MW solar project in the Philippines to align with renewable energy goals.
groups.narrative_zh: Alsons Power正在将菲律宾的一座55兆瓦柴油发电厂转型为98.7兆瓦的太阳能项目，以契合可再生能源目标。
groups.R_reason: Project completion is a binary state.

groups.name: ICTSI AIIB Infrastructure Loan
groups.name_zh: ICTSI获得亚投行港口基础设施贷款
groups.narrative: ICTSI secured a $300-million loan from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank for terminal and port expansion.
groups.narrative_zh: ICTSI从亚洲基础设施投资银行获得了3亿美元贷款，用于港口码头的扩建。
groups.R_reason: Loan disbursement and terminal milestone completion.
groups.U_reason: Capital has been secured, milestones are project management details.

groups.name: FedEx Clark Facility Expansion
groups.name_zh: 联邦快递克拉克枢纽扩建
groups.narrative: FedEx has commenced a significant expansion project at its Clark facility to enhance regional logistics capabilities.
groups.narrative_zh: 联邦快递已在其克拉克设施启动重大扩建项目，以提升区域物流能力。
groups.R_reason: Expansion project milestones.

groups.name: PAFFP Farmer Financial Assistance
groups.name_zh: PAFFP农户财政补助
groups.narrative: Government financial assistance programs like PAFFP are distributing aid to thousands of farmers in Tarlac and Albay to offset rising fuel and production costs.
groups.narrative_zh: PAFFP等政府财政援助项目正在向塔拉克和阿尔拜省的数千名农民发放补助，以抵消日益增长的燃料和生产成本。
groups.R_reason: Distribution of aid is measurable by count of recipients/payout.

groups.name: Philippine Airlines and Qatar Airways Partnership
groups.name_zh: 菲律宾航空与卡塔尔航空合作
groups.narrative: Philippine Airlines and Qatar Airways have expanded their strategic codeshare partnership to improve connectivity across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.
groups.narrative_zh: 菲律宾航空与卡塔尔航空扩大了战略代码共享合作伙伴关系，以加强东南亚、中东和欧洲之间的连通性。
groups.R_reason: Codeshare effectiveness is difficult to quantify for a bet.
groups.resolution_source: Civil Aeronautics Board of the Philippines

groups.name: Anti-Political Dynasty Bill
groups.name_zh: 反政治王朝法案
groups.narrative: The House of Representatives has approved the anti-political dynasty bill on second reading, marking a legislative attempt to curb concentrated political power.
groups.narrative_zh: 众议院二读通过了反政治王朝法案，标志着在限制政治权力集中方面的立法尝试。
groups.R_reason: Legislation status is binary (Passed or Failed).
groups.suggested_question: Will the Anti-Political Dynasty Bill pass into law by the end of the 20th Congress?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 到第20届国会结束时，《反政治王朝法案》是否会正式立法？
groups.resolution_source: Official Gazette / Congress of the Philippines

groups.name: Misamis Oriental Steel Plant Probe
groups.name_zh: 米沙鄢东部钢厂调查
groups.narrative: Defense Secretary Teodoro has warned against interference in the probe regarding allegedly radiologically-contaminated steel bars at a Misamis Oriental plant.
groups.narrative_zh: 国防部长特奥多罗警告称，不得干预对米沙鄢东部某钢厂涉嫌受放射性污染钢筋的调查。
groups.R_reason: Investigation results can be vague or classified.

groups.name: WPS Infrastructure Dispute
groups.name_zh: 西菲律宾海基础设施争端
groups.narrative: The DND has rejected China's opposition to ongoing Philippine infrastructure projects within the West Philippine Sea.
groups.narrative_zh: 国防部拒绝了中国对菲律宾在西菲律宾海持续进行基础设施建设项目的反对意见。
groups.R_reason: Infrastructure status is binary (Continued or Halted).
groups.U_reason: Dependent on external pressure and Chinese actions.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Philippine government suspend infrastructure projects in the West Philippine Sea due to Chinese opposition before 2027?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 菲律宾政府是否会在2027年前因中国的反对而暂停西菲律宾海的基础设施项目？
groups.resolution_source: Department of National Defense / Official Government press statement

groups.name: Marcos Jr. on Taiwan Conflict
groups.name_zh: 马科斯关于台湾冲突的立场
groups.narrative: President Marcos indicated that the Philippines would likely be compelled to engage if conflict erupted in the Taiwan Strait.
groups.narrative_zh: 马科斯总统表示，如果台海爆发冲突，菲律宾将难以避免被卷入。
groups.R_reason: Involvement is ambiguous; 'engagement' can mean humanitarian aid vs military support.

groups.name: PBA and Local Basketball Updates
groups.name_zh: PBA及本地篮球动态
groups.narrative: Recent basketball updates include Chot Reyes focusing on TNT's health and the expansion of the Alas Pilipinas women's pool.
groups.narrative_zh: 近期篮球动态包括乔特·雷耶斯（Chot Reyes）对TNT球队健康状况的关注，以及Alas Pilipinas女篮集训队规模的扩大。

groups.name: PH Student Science Achievement
groups.name_zh: 菲学生国际科学竞赛奖项
groups.narrative: Filipino students secured six awards at a global science fair in Arizona, earning national recognition.
groups.narrative_zh: 菲律宾学生在亚利桑那州举行的全球科学博览会上斩获六个奖项，获得国内表彰。

groups.name: PVL Coaching Awards

groups.narrative_zh: Ricafort被评为PVL年度教练，Bundit则被认可为Spikers' Turf的最佳导师。
groups.R_reason: Awards are binary official decisions.

groups.name: Rizal Memorial Redevelopment
groups.name_zh: 黎刹纪念体育场改造
groups.narrative: The Philippine Sports Commission and the City of Manila are collaborating on a shared vision for the redevelopment of the historic Rizal Memorial Sports Complex.
groups.narrative_zh: 菲律宾体育委员会与马尼拉市政府正在合作，共同制定历史悠久的黎刹纪念体育综合体的改造愿景。
groups.R_reason: Project milestones in government infrastructure are monitorable.
groups.U_reason: Bureaucratic delay is the primary risk.

groups.name: Siargao Tourism and Security
groups.name_zh: 锡亚高旅游业及安全事件
groups.narrative: Recent incidents involving tourist assaults in Siargao have prompted calls for dialogue regarding local business security.
groups.narrative_zh: 锡亚高近期发生的游客遇袭事件引发了关于地方商业安全的对话呼吁。
groups.R_reason: Regulations are official documents.

groups.name: Baguio Tourism Trends
groups.name_zh: 碧瑶旅游业趋势
groups.narrative: Baguio's tourism sector is in a recovery phase, though local businesses report ongoing post-pandemic challenges.
groups.narrative_zh: 碧瑶旅游业正处于恢复阶段，尽管当地企业报告称疫情后的挑战依然存在。
groups.R_reason: Tourism statistics are subject to estimation and reporting delay.

groups.name: Kim Robert de Leon DBM Appointment
groups.name_zh: 金·罗伯特·德莱昂获任预算部长
groups.narrative: President Marcos has appointed Kim Robert de Leon as the Acting Secretary of the Department of Budget and Management.
groups.narrative_zh: 马科斯总统已任命金·罗伯特·德莱昂为预算与管理部代理部长。
groups.R_reason: Commission on Appointments status.

groups.name: Spanish Pork Import Ban Lifted
groups.name_zh: 西班牙猪肉进口禁令解除

groups.narrative_zh: 菲律宾已解除对西班牙猪肉的进口禁令，以解决国内供应短缺问题。

groups.name_zh: 米沙鄢甘蔗虫害爆发
